figures.caption: Figure 1. Overview of the proposed USE-FM. TUEG is used for large-scale self-supervised pretraining through EEG signal reconstruction with an MSE loss. The pretrained encoder is then frozen and evaluated on TUAB and TUEP. The learned latent representations are further analyzed using k-means clustering, PCA, and t-SNE on TUEP.

Figure 2. Frozen-encoder transfer performance on (a) TUAB and (b) TUEP. Error bars indicate one standard deviation across independent runs. USE-FM is shown in light blue, LUNA-Base in light gray, and CBraMod in soft green.

Figure 4. PCA visualization of the latent representations learned by USE-FM, LUNA-Base, and CBraMod using the k = 4 clustering solution determined by the WCSS elbow criterion. Points are colored according to their assigned latent states. USE-FM exhibits a well-structured latent organization comparable to larger pretrained EEG foundation models while requiring substantially fewer parameters.

Figure 5. t-SNE visualization of the latent manifolds learned by USE-FM, LUNA-Base, and CBraMod. Colors denote the same four latent states shown in Fig. 4. Compared with the baselines, USE-FM exhibits four latent states distributed across distinct and continuous regions of the learned manifold.
